descriptions.w3d_d30e_read_entries_801aecf0: Reads the entry list from a reader: gets the count through slot 40, reserves the vector at +20, then for each entry reads its identifier (Type), object (Graph) and name (Name) through slots 36, 6 and 35 and appends it with unmodified STLport push_back. Returns the last result; a failure stops at once. Names are inferred.
